title: Sending the Seventy-Two and the Good Samaritan

questions.question: How many others did the Lord appoint and send on ahead of Him, two by two, into every town and place where He Himself was about to go?
options: Seventy-two (or seventy)
Twelve
One hundred and twenty
Four
questions.explanation: Luke 10:1 (ESV): "After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them on ahead of him, two by two, into every town and place where he himself was about to go." (Some manuscripts say 70).

questions.question: What did Jesus say they should pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to do, because the harvest is plentiful but the laborers are few?
options: To send out laborers into his harvest
To send angels to gather the harvest
To wither the fields of the unrighteous
To multiply the remaining grain
questions.correctAnswer: To send out laborers into his harvest
questions.explanation: Luke 10:2 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few. Therefore pray earnestly to the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest.'"

questions.question: Jesus told the seventy-two: "Go your way; behold, I am sending you out as..." what?
options: lambs in the midst of wolves
lions in the midst of sheep
doves among the serpents
warriors without swords
questions.correctAnswer: lambs in the midst of wolves
questions.explanation: Luke 10:3 (ESV): "Go your way; behold, I am sending you out as lambs in the midst of wolves."

questions.question: When the seventy-two enter a house, what should they first say?
options: "Peace be to this house!"
"The kingdom of God belongs here!"
"Repent and believe the gospel!"
"We come in the name of Jesus!"
questions.explanation: Luke 10:5 (ESV): "Whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house!'"

questions.question: When the seventy-two returned with joy, saying, "Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!", what did Jesus say He saw?
options: "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven."
"I saw the angels fighting alongside you."
"I saw Moses nodding in approval on the mount."
"I saw the abyss open to swallow the demons."
questions.correctAnswer: "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven."
questions.explanation: Luke 10:18 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.'"

questions.question: Jesus told them not to rejoice that the spirits are subject to them, but rather to rejoice that what has occurred?
options: That their names are written in heaven
That they have great faith to lead others
That the kingdom has reached the Gentiles
That the Pharisees will finally listen
questions.correctAnswer: That their names are written in heaven
questions.explanation: Luke 10:20 (ESV): "Nevertheless, do not rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

questions.question: A lawyer stood up to put Jesus to the test, asking what he must do to inherit eternal life. Jesus replied, "What is written in the Law?" The lawyer quoted the two greatest commandments. Wanting to justify himself, what question did the lawyer then ask?
options: "And who is my neighbor?"
"And how many times must I forgive?"
"And do I love God with all my might?"
"And what do I do if I am poor?"
questions.explanation: Luke 10:29 (ESV): "But he, desiring to justify himself, said to Jesus, 'And who is my neighbor?'"

questions.question: In the Parable of the Good Samaritan, a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho. What happened to him?
options: He fell among robbers, who stripped him and beat him and departed, leaving him half dead
He was arrested by a Roman legion for rebellion
He became violently ill on the side of the road
His camel was crippled and he had no food left
questions.correctAnswer: He fell among robbers, who stripped him and beat him and departed, leaving him half dead
questions.explanation: Luke 10:30 (ESV): "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who stripped him and beat him and departed, leaving him half dead."

questions.question: Which two figures saw the beaten man and passed by on the other side?
options: A priest and a Levite
A Pharisee and a Sadducee
A Roman soldier and an innkeeper
A scribe and an elder
questions.explanation: Luke 10:31-32 (ESV): "Now by chance a priest was going down that road... So likewise a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side."

questions.question: When the Samaritan saw the man, he had compassion, bound his wounds (pouring on oil and wine), set him on his animal, and took him where?
options: To an inn
To the temple in Jerusalem
To a nearby hospital tent
To his own house in Samaria
questions.explanation: Luke 10:34 (ESV): "He went to him and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he set him on his own animal and brought him to an inn and took care of him."

questions.question: What did the Samaritan give the innkeeper the next day, saying, "Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I come back"?
options: Two denarii
Five talents of silver
A gold coin
Thirty pieces of silver
questions.explanation: Luke 10:35 (ESV): "And the next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper, saying, 'Take care of him, and whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I come back.'"

questions.question: When asked which of the three proved to be a neighbor to the man who fell among the robbers, how did the lawyer reply?
options: "The one who showed him mercy."
"The Samaritan."
"The one who spent his two denarii."
"None of them, for the man was unclean."
questions.explanation: Luke 10:37 (ESV): "He said, 'The one who showed him mercy.' And Jesus said to him, 'You go, and do likewise.'"

questions.question: Jesus entered a village and a woman named Martha welcomed Him into her house. She had a sister called Mary, who did what?
options: Sat at the Lord's feet and listened to his teaching
Helped Martha prepare an elaborate feast
Washed Jesus' feet with expensive perfume
Went into the city to gather more food
questions.correctAnswer: Sat at the Lord's feet and listened to his teaching
questions.explanation: Luke 10:39 (ESV): "And she had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord's feet and listened to his teaching."

questions.question: Why was Martha distracted?
options: She was distracted with much serving
She was arguing with the disciples outside
She was mourning the recent loss of her husband
She was weaving cloth for the Temple
questions.correctAnswer: She was distracted with much serving
questions.explanation: Luke 10:40 (ESV): "But Martha was distracted with much serving."

questions.question: When Martha complained that Mary left her to serve alone, Jesus replied: "Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is necessary..." What did He say about Mary?
options: "Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."
"Mary knows the law and you know the kitchen."
"Mary will have her reward when the feast is done."
"Let her rest, for tomorrow she will serve you."
questions.correctAnswer: "Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."
questions.explanation: Luke 10:42 (ESV): "but one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her."

key_verse_text: And he answered, "You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind, and your neighbor as yourself."
